text: Applied economics is a branch of economics that focuses on solving practical economic problems. It emphasizes the integration of economic theories and methods with real industries, policies, and markets. Through quantitative analysis, model construction, and data validation, it provides solutions for business decision-making, government policy-making, and industry development. The core lies in "application", emphasizing the guiding role of theory in practice, covering all dimensions from micro-market analysis to macroeconomic policies, and serving as a bridge connecting economic theory with real economic activities.
